verdict.rationale: Lago is open-source and self-hostable (Docker), invoices can be downloaded, revenue analytics can be exported to CSV, and the full OpenAPI 3.1 schema/API gives programmatic access to all billing data for building your own exports. However, there is no explicit documented bulk-export or full-account data-portability feature (e.g., a one-click 'export everything' or GDPR-style dump), so leaving with 'all' data relies on assembling it via API calls rather than a turnkey export. Missing for 10: a documented complete-account export/migration tool, explicit data-portability guarantee, independent confirmation of successful full data exports by users.
